metadata.name: Customer Operations Team
metadata.description: Complete customer support workflow with triage, support specialists, and escalation handling

agents.name: Triage Agent
agents.description: First-line support agent that categorizes and routes customer inquiries
agents.instructions: You are the triage agent. Quickly assess customer inquiries, categorize them by type and urgency, and route to the appropriate support agent or escalation path.

agents.name: Support Specialist
agents.description: Handles customer inquiries, troubleshoots issues, and provides solutions
agents.instructions: You are a support specialist. Handle customer inquiries with empathy and professionalism. Troubleshoot issues, provide clear solutions, and escalate complex cases when needed.

agents.name: Escalation Manager
agents.description: Handles complex customer issues requiring human intervention or executive decisions
agents.instructions: You are the escalation manager. Handle complex issues that require human judgment, coordinate with human staff for critical decisions, and ensure high-priority customers receive appropriate attention.

goals.title: Build Knowledge Base

goals.title: Optimize Response Times
goals.description: Achieve and maintain target SLAs for all ticket categories

work_items.title: Define ticket categories
work_items.description: Establish taxonomy for issue types, urgency levels, and routing rules

work_items.title: Create response templates
work_items.description: Develop standard responses for common customer inquiries

work_items.title: Setup escalation criteria
work_items.description: Define when and how to escalate issues to human staff
